The hosted pin check failed twice before passing, retained under evidence/pin-attempt-1/ and pin-attempt-2/. `skills update` re-runs `add` without -a, which installs for the detected calling agent, or for every installed agent when none is detected. This preparation ran inside Claude Code, so update added Claude Code copies that the Codex-scoped removal did not remove. The 6558374 run was called from Codex. The passing run strips agent markers and sets AI_AGENT=codex, matching that caller; no OpenMapStack payload was involved.
Copied project/global install checks pass -a codex explicitly and never call update; their removal assertion passed under this session's environment.
